Adults 18+ only. Be honest about your identity and intentions. Respect consent and boundaries. Harassment, impersonation, scams and inappropriate content are not allowed. Never pressure someone to involve family or share private information.

Take your time. Never send money to someone you have only met online. Keep identity documents, financial information and your address private. Meet in public and tell someone you trust.\n\nYou may block, report or unmatch at any time. If you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency services.
